# transcdr_organization (Data Source)

The organization the API key belongs to: its plan and the plan's features, e.g. to check for `integrations` or `webhooks` before creating connections or event destinations. Needs `org:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "transcdr_organization" "this" {}

# Connections and automations need the integrations feature.
locals {
  can_automate = contains(data.transcdr_organization.this.features, "integrations")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `billing_email` (String) The billing contact.
- `features` (List of String) The plan's features, e.g. `hls`, `webhooks`, `api`, `integrations`.
- `id` (String) The organization id, `org_…`.
- `max_concurrent_jobs` (Number) Jobs that may run at once.
- `max_resolution` (Number) The largest short side a rendition may have on this plan.
- `name` (String) The organization's name.
- `plan` (String) The plan id, e.g. `starter`.
- `plan_name` (String) The plan's display name.
- `priority` (Boolean) Whether `priority = "high"` is allowed.
- `retention_days` (Number) How long outputs are kept.
- `slug` (String) The organization's slug.
- `suspended` (Boolean) Suspended organizations cannot create jobs.
